#Can I Register Multiple Accounts?

  • No, we strictly prohibit the registration of multiple accounts. Once the rules are violated, the account will be restricted, and many benefits will be lost.


#What Are The Deposit And Withdrawal Limits?

  • The minimum deposit is AUD10.
  • The minimum withdraw is AUD20.
  • Deposits of any amount require a X1 Rollover (Total Bets).
  • Withdrawal are limited to 5 times per day.


#If I still have a balance, can I make another deposit?

  • To avoid confusion in bonus rules, you should play and wager your points after each deposit and bonus acquisition. Once your points go below AUD1 to "Clear Balance" or after withdrawal, you can submit the deposit again.


#What is Our Rollover and Turnover?

  • Different companies have different abbreviations and rules, but in our company, there are only Rollover and Turnover, following the instructions below.
  • ROLLOVER: Total Game Bets.
  • TURNOVER: Minimum Withdraw / Remaining Credit.


#Can I combine multiple bonuses at the same time?

  • No, you cannot apply for multiple promotions, bonuses, refunds, commissions, redpacket, etc , at the same time.
  • While you might sometimes be able to activate various different bonuses, this overrides withdrawal rules across different bonuses. Once the rules are violated, the bonus will be forfeited.


#Why do gaming platforms sometimes disappear?

  • To provide a better and more different gaming environment, some gaming platforms occasionally undergo maintenance.
  • During the maintenance period, the gaming platform will be temporarily removed from the website, and once the repairs are completed, the gaming platform will be placed back on the website.


#What should I do if my credits disappear during game maintenance

  • During game maintenance, your credits will be held within the game until the maintenance is completed, at which point your scores will be restored..


#I've met the rollover requirements, why can't I withdraw?

  • The deposit when requesting a bonus will have rollover requirements. Once you complete the rollover requirements, please exit the game completely and give the system some time to update the rollover progress bar.
  • Once the rollover progress bar is complete, withdrawals can be made.


#What should I do if I can't receive the verification code?

  • To register a new user or reset a password if you've forgotten it, you need to request a verification code. However, there might be times when you don't receive the verification code.
